title: Where does the workflow begin relative to idea exploration, Align and room setup?
question: Where does the workflow begin relative to idea exploration, Align and room setup?
answer: SKW-1: Idea exploration may precede Align; grill-me, wayfinder or brainstorm can start Align; a grilling session starts with grill-me. Genesis and Adoption are first-time setup or update, not the governing workflow, and Genesis requires a grilling session afterward to form the Blueprint.
